费尔金.lore: An exile devoted to the dark, studying both sorcery and miracles.

巡礼者格兰达尔.name: Darkdiver Grandahl
巡礼者格兰达尔.lore: Waits at the entrance to the ancient Abyss for those who seek the dark.

温格之首.name: Head of Vengarl
温格之首.lore: A severed head that still tells travelers of the past.

曼斯库匹恩塔克.name: Manscorpion Tark
曼斯库匹恩塔克.lore: A giant scorpion warrior who rejects blind hatred.

宫廷魔术师纳瓦蓝.name: Royal Sorcerer Navlaan
宫廷魔术师纳瓦蓝.lore: A two-faced mage imprisoned in Aldia's Keep, testing travelers with sorcery and assassination requests.

巫女雅莉珊卓.name: Alsanna, Silent Oracle
巫女雅莉珊卓.lore: Changed by a fragment of the Abyss, this oracle still watches over the Ivory King.

王城宰相韦拉格.name: Chancellor Wellager
王城宰相韦拉格.lore: A spectral chancellor who keeps his post at Drangleic Castle.

持剑游魂步兵.name: Hollow Infantry Swordsman
持剑游魂步兵.lore: One of the remaining foot soldiers in the Forest of Fallen Giants.

持盾王国士兵.name: Royal Shield Soldier
持盾王国士兵.lore: A shield-bearing soldier who still holds position under old orders.

森林火蜥蜴.name: Forest Flame Salamander
森林火蜥蜴.lore: Lies in a cavern and spits an endless stream of fireballs.

海德骑士.name: Heide Knight
海德骑士.lore: A silent knight in white armor, armed with a lightning-infused weapon.

古老骑士.name: Old Knight
古老骑士.lore: A heavily armored guardian of the Tower of Flame, slow but unyielding.

瓦兰吉水手.name: Varangian Sailor
瓦兰吉水手.lore: A pirate of No-man's Wharf who greets enemies with continuous twin-blade slashes.

暗影刺客.name: Suspicious Shadow
暗影刺客.lore: A lightly armored assassin who ambushes travelers at the docks.

长臂暗栖者.name: Dark Stalker
长臂暗栖者.lore: A creature afraid of fire whose long arms command the paths of No-man's Wharf.

王国剑士.name: Royal Swordsman
王国剑士.lore: A soldier of the old kingdom, stationed in the Lost Bastille.

爆炸游魂.name: Exploding Hollow
爆炸游魂.lore: A deranged prisoner who hurls itself at an enemy before igniting its own body.

囚笼狱卒.name: Bastille Jailer
囚笼狱卒.lore: Controls the corridors with a polearm and barrels of explosives.

狩猎森林骷髅.name: Huntsman's Copse Skeleton
狩猎森林骷髅.lore: Gathers among the trees under the command of necromancers.

双刀骷髅.name: Dual-Blade Skeleton
双刀骷髅.lore: Closes the distance quickly before swinging a pair of curved swords.

车轮骷髅.name: Skeleton Wheel
车轮骷髅.lore: A skeleton turned into a fast rolling wheel, scraping through corridors.

镰刀胖子.name: Scythe Wielder
镰刀胖子.lore: A towering execution-ground guard sweeping enemies with a heavy scythe.

狩猎森林施术者.name: Huntsman's Copse Necromancer
狩猎森林施术者.lore: A spellcaster who revives skeletons from the shadows of the execution ground.

巨型镰刀守卫.name: Giant Sickle Guard
巨型镰刀守卫.lore: A ponderous guard holding the narrow approach to Earthen Peak.

沙之魔术师.name: Desert Sorceress
沙之魔术师.lore: Casts pyromancies with a fiery fan and an alluring pose.

毒角甲虫.name: Poison Horn Beetle
毒角甲虫.lore: Crawls through the poisoned marshes, releasing toxic gas.

猎犬鼠.name: Rat Hound
猎犬鼠.lore: A vicious rat-like beast as large as a hound.

狮子战士.name: Lion Warrior
狮子战士.lore: A beastman in the Shaded Woods, advancing with an axe raised.

无形盗贼.name: Invisible Rogue
无形盗贼.lore: A translucent blade-wielder hiding within the misty woods.

马斯托顿战士.name: Mastodon Warrior
马斯托顿战士.lore: An elephant-headed warrior in heavy armor, guarding Drangleic Castle and the Doors of Pharros with a halberd.

盖尔姆战士.name: Gyrm Warrior
盖尔姆战士.lore: A stocky warrior in thick armor, defending the Doors of Pharros with a heavy axe.

盖尔姆投斧手.name: Gyrm Axe Thrower
盖尔姆投斧手.lore: Hurls enormous axes from above to seal off the passage.

蜘蛛寄生人.name: Spider Host
蜘蛛寄生人.lore: A resident infested by Brightstone spiders.

辉石蜘蛛.name: Brightstone Spider
辉石蜘蛛.lore: A spider gathering with its brood on mine walls and rooftops.

辉石法师.name: Brightstone Mage
辉石法师.lore: A sorcerer of the mining town who commands soul magic.

阿玛那祭司.name: Amana Priestess
阿玛那祭司.lore: Guards the flooded shrine with long-range, homing soul arrows.

阿玛那异形.name: Amana Aberration
阿玛那异形.lore: Lurks beneath the water, waiting for a chance to ambush its prey.

王城石像士兵.name: Drangleic Stone Soldier
王城石像士兵.lore: Awakens from the form of a statue when an intruder draws near.

王城茫然卫兵.name: Drangleic Ruin Sentinel
王城茫然卫兵.lore: A halberd-bearing construct hidden in a secret chamber.

龙祭坛卫兵.name: Dragon Shrine Guardian
龙祭坛卫兵.lore: Defends the pilgrim's road with an enormous golden weapon.

龙血骑士.name: Drakeblood Knight
龙血骑士.lore: Seeks dragon blood with a greatsword imbued with lightning and magic.

萨尔瓦圣壁士兵.name: Sanctum Soldier
萨尔瓦圣壁士兵.lore: A soldier of Shulva, guarding the slumber of the ancient dragon.

幽灵圣壁骑士.name: Sanctum Knight Phantom
幽灵圣壁骑士.lore: Keeps a spectral body while its true remains lie elsewhere.

黑魔女.name: Leydia Witch
黑魔女.lore: Uses dark magic against those who enter the Undead Crypt.

无礼者.name: Imperious Knight
无礼者.lore: A shield-bearing undead guard watching over the graves.

铁龟战士.name: Ironclad Soldier
铁龟战士.lore: A thick backplate protects this armored soldier from attacks from behind.

亚伦骑士.name: Alonne Knight
亚伦骑士.lore: An eastern swordsman serving in the Iron Keep.

亚伦骑士长.name: Alonne Knight Captain
亚伦骑士长.lore: A red-armored captain who can fire a greatbow from afar.

铁牢火术师.name: Iron Keep Pyromancer
铁牢火术师.lore: A spellcaster in the Iron Keep, projecting flames from a long staff.

灰烬战士.name: Ashen Warrior
灰烬战士.lore: A gray warrior who repeatedly gathers for battle in Brume Tower.

熔铁士兵.name: Fume Soldier
熔铁士兵.lore: A cast-iron swordsman serving within the tower.

持巨锤熔铁战士.name: Iron Warrior
持巨锤熔铁战士.lore: Shatters intruders with a blazing great hammer.

冰冻士兵.name: Frozen Soldier
冰冻士兵.lore: A loyal soldier of the old, frozen royal city.

冰冻刺猬.name: Frozen Hedgehog
冰冻刺猬.lore: An ice-covered spiny beast that rolls into enemies.

无形战士.name: Invisible Warrior
无形战士.lore: An outlying guardian whose form is hidden by snow and wind.

卡利姆的罗德里克.name: Knight Lautrec of Carim
卡利姆的罗德里克.lore: A favored knight who wields paired shotels and covets the Fire Keeper's soul. His base Attack is normally 0. It becomes 3 only while the living enemy directly opposite has 0 Attack. Against an empty lane or a foe with nonzero Attack, his base Attack remains 0. Additional Attack bonuses are counted separately: he excels at striking the defenseless.

守墓人亚格德蓝.name: Grave Warden Agdayne
守墓人亚格德蓝.lore: Guards the entrance to the Undead Crypt and teaches hexes, warning travelers not to disturb the dead.

方阵.name: Phalanx
方阵.lore: Shield-bearing slimes gather into a formation with a formidable front line.

塔楼骑士.name: Tower Knight
塔楼骑士.lore: An immense shield and spear seal off the front, while heavy footsteps press the battle line.

贯穿骑士.name: Penetrator
贯穿骑士.lore: A long sword pierces the defense, driving targets back with powerful thrusts.

拦路恶魔.name: Vanguard Demon
拦路恶魔.lore: A demon wielding a giant axe, using heavy blows to dominate a narrow path.

旧日勇士.name: Old Hero
旧日勇士.lore: A blind warrior of antiquity who swings his great blade at the sound of his enemy.

食人鬼.name: Maneaters
食人鬼.lore: Winged stone demons circling the narrow bridges of the high tower.

伪王欧兰特.name: False King Allant
伪王欧兰特.lore: A false king who steals souls, overwhelming foes with swift swordplay and dark power.

老王欧兰特.name: King Allant
老王欧兰特.lore: A king devoured by demonic power, stripped of his former majesty.

铠甲蜘蛛.name: Armor Spider
铠甲蜘蛛.lore: Weaves fire and webs together, turning the mine tunnel into a burning trap.

炎魔.name: Flamelurker
炎魔.lore: A fiery demon in the depths of the mine, charging furiously when enraged.

龙神.name: Dragon God
龙神.lore: An immense dragon whose searing breath destroys everything in its path.

愚者的偶像.name: Fool's Idol
愚者的偶像.lore: Creates illusory copies to confuse intruders as spells strike from many directions.

黄衣老者.name: Old Monk
黄衣老者.lore: A host to the yellow robes who tests challengers with sorcery and close combat.

风暴王.name: Storm King
风暴王.lore: An enormous flying demon commanding the airborne storm beasts.

审判者.name: Adjudicator
审判者.lore: Its enormous body endures attacks while its long tongue and blade pursue prey.

吸血虫聚合体.name: Leechmonger
吸血虫聚合体.lore: A creature made from leeches, using its swarms to mend its wounds.

污秽巨像.name: Dirty Colossus
污秽巨像.lore: A hulking mass of filth that unleashes swarms of insects to befoul the battlefield.

少女阿斯特蕾亚.name: Maiden Astraea
少女阿斯特蕾亚.lore: Saves the abandoned through miracles, her prayers carrying the power to heal.

黑衣少女.name: Maiden in Black
黑衣少女.lore: Guides the power of souls and offers aid to those who have lost their way.

要人.name: The Monumental
要人.lore: A watcher over the Nexus who speaks of an ancient duty.

圣者于尔班.name: Saint Urbain
圣者于尔班.lore: A saint who teaches miracles and gives support through faith.

于尔班的信徒.name: Disciple of God
于尔班的信徒.lore: A follower of the saint who guards their faith in miracles.

瑟琳·文兰.name: Selen Vinland
瑟琳·文兰.lore: A knight searching for her brother, sustained by devout faith.

加尔·文兰.name: Garl Vinland
加尔·文兰.lore: Guards the maiden to the very end with a giant hammer and a dark silver shield.

托马斯.name: Stockpile Thomas
托马斯.lore: A storekeeper who watches over the belongings of travelers.

铁匠鲍德温.name: Blacksmith Boldwin
铁匠鲍德温.lore: An elderly blacksmith who repairs and forges weapons in the Nexus.

铁匠艾德.name: Blacksmith Ed
铁匠艾德.lore: A blacksmith of Stonefang Tunnel, skilled in forging unusual weapons.

颓丧战士.name: Crestfallen Warrior
颓丧战士.lore: A dejected warrior sitting in the Nexus, gradually losing the will to fight.

奥斯特拉瓦.name: Ostrava of Boletaria
奥斯特拉瓦.lore: A prince wandering the royal city, protecting himself with sword and shield.

比约尔.name: Biorr of the Twin Fangs
比约尔.lore: A heavily armored Twin Fang knight who supports challengers with greatsword, shield and crossbow.

老王多兰.name: Old King Doran
老王多兰.lore: An ancient warrior in heavy armor, guarding the royal mausoleum.

米兰达.name: Executioner Miralda
米兰达.lore: An axe-wielding executioner who hunts intruders deep within the royal city.

斯克维尔.name: Scirvir, the Wanderer
斯克维尔.lore: A wanderer seeking rare ores, familiar with the secrets of the tunnels.

五月.name: Satsuki
五月.lore: A swordsman seeking a cursed blade, willing to stake his life on his obsession.

恶魂·帕奇.name: Patches, the Hyena
恶魂·帕奇.lore: A merchant living by traps and lies, skilled at trading places when it suits him.

肮脏男人.name: Filthy Man
肮脏男人.lore: An ore merchant in Stonefang Tunnel.

肮脏女人.name: Filthy Woman
肮脏女人.lore: A merchant in the Valley of Defilement who knows its foul ground well.

王城奴隶商人.name: Dregling Merchant
王城奴隶商人.lore: A merchant hiding in the royal city, selling supplies for survival.

墓掘者布莱吉.name: Graverobber Blige
墓掘者布莱吉.lore: A merchant imprisoned at the Shrine of Storms, familiar with the underground paths.

闪闪鸟.name: Sparkly the Crow
闪闪鸟.lore: A mysterious bird who trades gifts for bright and shiny things.

尤特.name: Yurt, the Silent Chief
尤特.lore: A silent assassin who finds openings and strikes without a sound.

梅菲斯托费勒.name: Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒.lore: A mysterious visitor who plans assassinations and purchases willing blades.

魔女尤莉亚.name: Yuria the Witch
魔女尤莉亚.lore: An imprisoned witch who turns demon souls into powerful magic.

贤者弗瑞克.name: Sage Freke
贤者弗瑞克.lore: A sage studying soul sorcery, adept at directing magical power.

弗瑞克的徒弟.name: Freke's Apprentice
弗瑞克的徒弟.lore: Teaches basic spells in the Nexus while following the sage's research.

雷德尔.name: Lord Rydell
雷德尔.lore: An imprisoned soul noble, wielding a phosphorescent pole.

前王室贵妇.name: Once Royal Mistress
前王室贵妇.lore: Sings within the Tower of Latria and sells supplies for survival.

柏雷塔尼亚士兵.name: Boletarian Soldier
柏雷塔尼亚士兵.lore: A royal soldier armed with sword and shield, forming the basic defensive line.

王城弩兵.name: Boletarian Crossbowman
王城弩兵.lore: Fires bolts from afar, searching for openings behind the front line.

柏雷塔尼亚亡者.name: Boletarian Dregling
柏雷塔尼亚亡者.lore: A maddened resident of the royal city, swinging a broken weapon.

王城猎犬.name: Boletarian Hound
王城猎犬.lore: A swift hound that leaps upon intruders with its pack.

矿工.name: Scale Miner
矿工.lore: A laborer of Stonefang Tunnel who resists intruders with a pickaxe.

拉托利亚囚徒.name: Latria Prisoner
拉托利亚囚徒.lore: A prisoner trapped in the tower cells, slowly approaching outsiders.

骷髅弓手.name: Skeleton Archer
骷髅弓手.lore: A skeletal archer firing from afar, whose bones may remain even after death.

巨大蜱虫.name: Giant Tick
巨大蜱虫.lore: Its swollen body blocks the paths through the Valley of Defilement.

软泥怪.name: Sludge
软泥怪.lore: A viscous body that withstands slashes and slowly consumes intruders.

火蜥蜴.name: Fire Lizard
火蜥蜴.lore: Crawls along the scorching mine walls and drives enemies away with flame.

熔岩虫.name: Lava Worm
熔岩虫.lore: A heat-resistant insect guarding the lava paths within the mine.

影人.name: Shadowlurker
影人.lore: A dark figure summoned by a Reaper at the shrine, sustained by its caster.

拉托利亚石像鬼.name: Latria Gargoyle
拉托利亚石像鬼.lore: A winged stone creature of Latria, swooping through the narrow passages.

风暴兽.name: Storm Beast
风暴兽.lore: Circles above the Shrine of Storms, hurling spikes toward the ground.

腐朽谷堕落者.name: Depraved One
腐朽谷堕落者.lore: A defiled resident of the valley, attacking in groups with crude weapons.

巨型蛞蝓.name: Giant Slug
巨型蛞蝓.lore: An enormous mollusk gathering in the wetlands of the Valley of Defilement.

瘟疫鼠.name: Plague Rat
瘟疫鼠.lore: A rat gathering in filthy corners and spreading disease.

蚊群.name: Mosquito Swarm
蚊群.lore: Bloodsucking insects of the Valley of Defilement that cling to their prey.

蓝眼骑士.name: Blue Eye Knight
蓝眼骑士.lore: A shield-bearing knight of Boletaria, using a firm stance to hold off attacks.

红眼骑士.name: Red Eye Knight
红眼骑士.lore: An elite Boletarian knight, dangerous in both skill and armor.

王城密探.name: Imperial Spy
王城密探.lore: A swift assassin hidden in the shadows, striking with short blades.

银色骷髅.name: Silver Skeleton
银色骷髅.lore: A nimble sword-and-shield skeleton that rolls toward its enemies and shifts position.

金色骷髅.name: Gold Skeleton
金色骷髅.lore: An enormous skeleton with two heavy blades, overwhelming foes with force.

黑色骷髅.name: Black Skeleton
黑色骷髅.lore: An elite skeleton with twin swords, relentlessly pursuing its enemies.

巨大堕落者.name: Giant Depraved One
巨大堕落者.lore: An enormous valley resident blocking the passage with a heavy club.

夺心魔.name: Mind Flayer
夺心魔.lore: Hunts prisoners with bells and binding spells, its tentacles a deadly threat.

死神.name: Reaper
死神.lore: A scythe-bearing mage who commands specters; its fall ends their summoning.

肥胖官员.name: Fat Official
肥胖官员.lore: A cruel royal enforcer, casting fireballs and swinging a battle axe.

红龙.name: Red Dragon
红龙.lore: Circles the bridges of Boletaria, bathing the road in dragonfire.

蓝龙.name: Blue Dragon
蓝龙.lore: Dwells deep within Boletaria, halting any advance with searing dragonfire.

不死人.name: Undead
不死人.lore: The Undead's fighting style combines Fire with the sacrifice system.

巨鸦.name: Giant Crow
巨鸦.lore: The giant crow's fighting style combines Dark with the sacrifice system.

骷髅.name: Skeleton
骷髅.lore: The skeleton's fighting style combines Dark with the sacrifice system.

比欧.name: Biorr
比欧.lore: Biorr's fighting style combines Physical damage with the sacrifice system.

弗雷克.name: Freke
弗雷克.lore: Freke's fighting style combines Light with the sacrifice system.

乌尔班.name: Urbain
乌尔班.lore: Urbain's fighting style combines Dark with the sacrifice system.

老王奥兰特.name: Old King Allant
老王奥兰特.lore: Old King Allant's fighting style combines Dark with the sacrifice system.

亡者.name: Hollow
亡者.lore: The Hollow's fighting style combines Physical damage with the sacrifice system.

追逐者.name: Pursuer
追逐者.lore: The Pursuer's fighting style combines Dark with the sacrifice system.

亡灵商人.name: Undead Merchant
亡灵商人.lore: The Undead Merchant's fighting style combines Dark with the sacrifice system.

食尸虫.name: Carrion Worm
食尸虫.lore: The carrion worm's fighting style combines Dark with the sacrifice system.

游荡亡者.name: Wandering Hollow
游荡亡者.lore: The wandering Hollow's fighting style combines Physical damage with the sacrifice system.

灵体.name: Soul Remnant
灵体.lore: The soul remnant's fighting style combines Dark with the sacrifice system.

盲眼亡者.name: Blind Hollow
盲眼亡者.lore: The blind Hollow's fighting style combines Physical damage with the sacrifice system.

公爵的芙蕾雅·金辉.name: Gilded The Duke's Dear Freja
公爵的芙蕾雅·金辉.lore: The spider matriarch, the Duke's Dear Freja, shelters her unhatched brood in gilded silk. Even when their mother falls, her spiderlings keep watch over the nest.

亚尔特留斯·金辉.name: Gilded Knight Artorias
亚尔特留斯·金辉.lore: With every kill, the wolf knight reclaims a fragment of his lost resolve. His battered greatsword grows fiercer with each battle.

塔楼骑士·金辉.name: Gilded Tower Knight
塔楼骑士·金辉.lore: His raised shield reflects the golden light of the ancient royal city. Even wings that soar over its walls find nowhere to hide.

月光蝶·金辉.name: Gilded Moonlight Butterfly
月光蝶·金辉.lore: Moonlight gathers into gold upon the butterfly's wings, and arcane power drifts above the blades below.

薪王葛温·金辉.name: Gilded Gwyn, Lord of Cinder
薪王葛温·金辉.lore: The last thread of the First Flame slips from the king's palm, giving those who follow a little more warmth and life.

墓王尼特·金辉.name: Gilded Gravelord Nito
墓王尼特·金辉.lore: Countless bones sink into the long night, yet one golden ember refuses to go out and keeps watch where they fell.

灼烧的白王·金辉.name: Gilded Burnt Ivory King
灼烧的白王·金辉.lore: The Ivory King enters Chaos once more. His armor becomes kindling, so that the lives behind him need not fade with his own.

贯穿骑士·金辉.name: Gilded Penetrator
贯穿骑士·金辉.lore: His long sword parts the golden dust of battle. Every fallen defender makes the next charge more resolute.

风暴王·金辉.name: Gilded Storm King
风暴王·金辉.lore: Golden lightning sweeps along vast wings. When the storm passes, a new fate falls into your hand.

少女阿斯特蕾亚·金辉.name: Gilded Maiden Astraea
少女阿斯特蕾亚·金辉.lore: Even in the depths of corruption, someone remains gentle. The golden light she leaves behind abandons none of the wounded.

老王奥兰特·金辉.name: Gilded Old King Allant
老王奥兰特·金辉.lore: Golden light coils around a broken crown. Though his form is lost, the king still reaches for the last thread of a visitor's soul.

不死院恶魔·金辉.name: Gilded Asylum Demon
不死院恶魔·金辉.lore: The gatekeeper's hammer gleams with old gold. Each crashing blow beats every thought of escape back into the dust.

追逐者·金辉.name: Gilded Pursuer
追逐者·金辉.lore: Floating armor casts a golden shadow. Shield and greatsword catch those who thought they had escaped the curse.

镜之骑士·金辉.name: Gilded Looking Glass Knight
镜之骑士·金辉.lore: The mirror shield returns broken gold to the one who swings the blade. In the downpour, its reflection still studies every hesitation for the throne.

铠甲蜘蛛·金辉.name: Gilded Armor Spider
铠甲蜘蛛·金辉.lore: Molten gold coats the spider's shell in the mine tunnel. When the mother falls, tiny golden footsteps still fill the way back.

深渊之主马努斯·金辉.name: Gilded Manus, Father of the Abyss
深渊之主马努斯·金辉.lore: Surging humanity swallows the faintest gold. A huge arm drives darkness forward and drags the fallen warrior's obsession back into the depths.

熔铁恶魔·金辉.name: Gilded Smelter Demon
熔铁恶魔·金辉.lore: Molten gold runs through the cracks of its armor. Every blade that touches it remembers the furnace has not yet cooled.

烟之骑士雷姆·金辉.name: Gilded Fume Knight Raime
烟之骑士雷姆·金辉.lore: Ashes brighten the heavy black sword. The oath to guard the old king is spent; every remaining blow claims blood for the smoldering fire.

奥斯卡·金辉.name: Gilded Oscar of Astora
奥斯卡·金辉.lore: The last Estus Flask has already been given away. The knight's unextinguished soul still leaves hope for those who come after.

牛头恶魔·金辉.name: Gilded Taurus Demon
牛头恶魔·金辉.lore: Golden light crosses the battlements as a heavy axe sweeps through the wind toward anyone bold enough to climb the tower.

钟楼石像鬼·金辉.name: Gilded Bell Gargoyles
钟楼石像鬼·金辉.lore: Before the bell falls silent, twin wings kindle anew in golden light. The belfry's guardians refuse to let the road grow still.

帕奇·金辉.name: Gilded Trusty Patches
帕奇·金辉.lore: This bald trickster always waits for the moment you least expect to push you into the abyss. Now even his kicking boots are plated in gold.

索拉尔·金辉.name: Gilded Solaire of Astora
索拉尔·金辉.lore: The sun's golden light shines on a knight with arms raised high. Praise the sun, and praise those who still stand beside you.

魔女克拉格·金辉.name: Gilded Chaos Witch Quelaag
魔女克拉格·金辉.lore: The fire of Chaos spreads along her enchanted blade. She still guards the road that leads to her sister.

铁傀儡·金辉.name: Gilded Iron Golem
铁傀儡·金辉.lore: The iron wall of Sen's Fortress wears a golden sheen. Even the heaviest weapons struggle to move it.

奥恩斯坦·金辉.name: Gilded Dragonslayer Ornstein
奥恩斯坦·金辉.lore: A golden lion helm reflects dragonslaying lightning. Between the swift step and the spear, there is no moment to breathe.

斯莫·金辉.name: Gilded Executioner Smough
斯莫·金辉.lore: The great hammer falls, lifting golden light and dust together. The executioner's laughter still echoes through the hall.

卡拉米特·金辉.name: Gilded Black Dragon Kalameet
卡拉米特·金辉.lore: The eye of calamity opens in golden light. A curse feared even by ancient dragons descends once more.

最后的巨人·金辉.name: Gilded The Last Giant
最后的巨人·金辉.lore: Rage nailed to the past turns to gold. The severed arm remains his final weapon.

流放罪执行者·金辉.name: Gilded Flexile Sentry
流放罪执行者·金辉.lore: Golden light passes over the executioner's blades. In the hold below, there is no other side left to hide behind.

遗忘的罪人·金辉.name: Gilded The Lost Sinner
遗忘的罪人·金辉.lore: She raises the shackles she chose for herself. The golden light illuminates only the sin she wishes forgotten.

骷髅王·金辉.name: Gilded Skeleton Lords
骷髅王·金辉.lore: Bones rattle softly beneath the thrones. The gilded dead are still waiting for the next command.

毒妃米妲·金辉.name: Gilded Mytha, the Baneful Queen
毒妃米妲·金辉.lore: The poison pool reflects a golden crown. She still believes her severed beauty will earn a glance from the king.

铁之古王·金辉.name: Gilded Old Iron King
铁之古王·金辉.lore: Lava bears up a fallen crown. Even gold cannot fill the fractures left by the iron kingdom's collapse.

腐败物·金辉.name: Gilded The Rotten
腐败物·金辉.lore: Abandoned bodies join together in golden light. Every outstretched hand refuses to sink alone again.

娜香德拉·金辉.name: Gilded Nashandra
娜香德拉·金辉.lore: Desire approaches the throne dressed in gold. The fragment of darkness still craves a flame that was never hers.

王兄安第尔·金辉.name: Gilded Aldia, Scholar of the First Sin
王兄安第尔·金辉.lore: A flame beyond life, death and thrones asks from within its golden light: if there is no path, where will you go?

骑士亚伦·金辉.name: Gilded Sir Alonne
骑士亚伦·金辉.lore: An eastern blade reflects a solitary golden gleam. The knight still waits for a duel that leaves no room for excuses.

灰烬审判者古达.name: Iudex Gundyr
灰烬审判者古达.lore: The judge guarding the path to Firelink erupts with the Pus of Man hidden within him.

冷冽谷的玻尔多.name: Vordt of the Boreal Valley
冷冽谷的玻尔多.lore: A four-legged outrider knight corrupted by the Pontiff's ring.

咒蚀大树.name: Curse-rotted Greatwood
咒蚀大树.lore: The great tree bears the settlement's curses, with swollen growths marking its weak points.

结晶老者.name: Crystal Sage
结晶老者.lore: Crystal sorcery and illusory doubles give this sage control of the battlefield.

幽邃主教群.name: Deacons of the Deep
幽邃主教群.lore: The congregation prays together, passing the power of the Deep to its archdeacon.

深渊守望者.name: Abyss Watchers
深渊守望者.lore: Warriors bound by wolf blood slaughter one another, then rise together in flame.

霸王沃尼尔.name: High Lord Wolnir
霸王沃尼尔.lore: The skeletal ruler swallowed by the Abyss clings to sacred bracelets to hold his body together.

老恶魔王.name: Old Demon King
老恶魔王.lore: An ancient demon king survives into the fading age of Chaos.

教宗沙力万.name: Pontiff Sulyvahn
教宗沙力万.lore: The Pontiff wields two blades of judgment and summons a dark double to attack beside him.

吞噬神明的艾尔德利奇.name: Aldrich, Devourer of Gods
吞噬神明的艾尔德利奇.lore: The god-devouring sludge casts spells through the body of a god of the Darkmoon.

巨人尤姆.name: Yhorm the Giant
巨人尤姆.lore: The guilt-laden giant Lord of Cinder keeps watch over the throne of a ruined capital.

冷冽谷的舞娘.name: Dancer of the Boreal Valley
冷冽谷的舞娘.lore: Slow, measured steps turn suddenly into long, relentless combinations of twin blades.

妖王欧斯罗艾斯.name: Oceiros, the Consumed King
妖王欧斯罗艾斯.lore: His obsession with draconic power transformed him into a blind, dragonlike creature.

英雄古达.name: Champion Gundyr
英雄古达.lore: Untouched by the Abyss, Gundyr overwhelms opponents with halberd strikes and brutal close combat.

猎龙铠甲.name: Dragonslayer Armour
猎龙铠甲.lore: A suit of heavy dragonslaying armor animated by the Pilgrim Butterflies.

洛斯里克王子.name: Lothric, Younger Prince
洛斯里克王子.lore: The younger prince rejects the linking of the fire and aids his brother with miracles.

洛里安.name: Lorian, Elder Prince
洛里安.lore: Though his legs have failed him, the elder prince teleports to swing a flaming greatsword.

古老飞龙.name: Ancient Wyvern
古老飞龙.lore: A fire-breathing wyvern blocks the road through Archdragon Peak.

无名王者.name: Nameless King
无名王者.lore: An ancient god of war and dragonslayer who allied himself with a storm drake.

薪王们的化身.name: Soul of Cinder
薪王们的化身.lore: The lingering arts of all who linked the fire unite in its final guardian.

王者守墓人.name: Champion's Gravetender
王者守墓人.lore: With valor and a greatwolf at his side, he guards a grave within the painting.

守墓大狼.name: Gravetender Greatwolf
守墓大狼.lore: A greatwolf that charges across the snowfields at terrifying speed.

修女芙莉德.name: Sister Friede
修女芙莉德.lore: Her unseen frost scythe and black flame keep the painting from burning.

教父艾雷德尔.name: Father Ariandel
教父艾雷德尔.lore: Clutching his great basin, the father calls the sister back amid the flames.

恶魔王子.name: Demon Prince
恶魔王子.lore: The last embers of demonkind gather in a final prince who spreads his wings.

教堂之枪哈尔弗莱特.name: Halflight, Spear of the Church
教堂之枪哈尔弗莱特.lore: He protects the sleeping princess with a spear and a painted curved sword.

黑龙米狄尔.name: Darkeater Midir
黑龙米狄尔.lore: The ancient dragon that endured the dark breathes destruction deep within the Ringed City.

盖尔.name: Slave Knight Gael
盖尔.lore: The old knight who reached the world's end carries the blood of the Dark Soul.

防火女.name: Fire Keeper
防火女.lore: The Fire Keeper of Firelink Shrine transforms souls into strength.

霍克伍德.name: Hawkwood the Deserter
霍克伍德.lore: A crestfallen deserter who abandoned the covenant of the wolf's blood.

铁匠安德烈.name: Andre the Blacksmith
铁匠安德烈.lore: After countless years, he still forges weapons for the Unkindled.

祭祀场侍女.name: Shrine Handmaid
祭祀场侍女.lore: An old woman beside the ashes who buys and sells the relics of others.

库尔兰的鲁道斯.name: Ludleth of Courland
库尔兰的鲁道斯.lore: Though he has no legs, this Lord of Cinder willingly bears the duty of linking the fire.

约尔.name: Yoel of Londor
约尔.lore: The stone-shelled pilgrim draws out the dark power within the Unkindled.

尤莉亚.name: Yuria of Londor
尤莉亚.lore: A leader of the Sable Church who prepares the way for a Lord of Hollows.

安瑞.name: Anri of Astora
安瑞.lore: An exiled knight pursuing Aldrich, Devourer of Gods.

沉默骑士霍拉斯.name: Horace the Hushed
沉默骑士霍拉斯.lore: A silent, heavily armored knight who protects his traveling companion Anri.

西格瓦德.name: Siegward of Catarina
西格瓦德.lore: The onion knight accompanies the Unkindled with a promise and a raised cup.

不屈不挠的帕奇.name: Unbreakable Patches
不屈不挠的帕奇.lore: Age after age, he still delights in pushing travelers from great heights.

希里斯.name: Sirris of the Sunless Realms
希里斯.lore: A Darkmoon knight following an oath and the trail of her grandfather.

无名指的李奥纳多.name: Ringfinger Leonhard
无名指的李奥纳多.lore: An invader who gathers tongues for the Mother of Rebirth.

重生之母罗莎莉亚.name: Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth
重生之母罗莎莉亚.lore: Within the Cathedral of the Deep, she reshapes those who have lost their voices.

卡利姆的伊莉娜.name: Irina of Carim
卡利姆的伊莉娜.lore: A blind maiden who learns and teaches miracles.

卡利姆的伊果.name: Eygon of Carim
卡利姆的伊果.lore: The knight who protects Irina with Morne's great hammer.

奥贝克.name: Orbeck of Vinheim
奥贝克.lore: A solitary scholar willing to exchange knowledge of sorcery for scrolls.

大沼的柯弭库斯.name: Cornyx of the Great Swamp
大沼的柯弭库斯.lore: The caged pyromancer teaches the Unkindled to command flame.

卡露拉.name: Karla
卡露拉.lore: A child of darkness imprisoned in the dungeon who teaches forbidden pyromancies.

不死聚落的葛雷瑞特.name: Greirat of the Undead Settlement
不死聚落的葛雷瑞特.lore: A thief who repays his rescue by risking his life to steal supplies.

药指的海泽尔.name: Yellowfinger Heysel
药指的海泽尔.lore: The yellow-robed sorcerer among Rosaria's Fingers.

神圣骑士霍德里克.name: Holy Knight Hodrick
神圣骑士霍德里克.lore: A Mound-maker wandering near the Pit of Hollows.

猎杀骑士克雷顿.name: Creighton, Slayer of Knights
猎杀骑士克雷顿.lore: A killer from an old kingdom who has never abandoned the hunt.

巡礼者隆道尔的苍白影子.name: Londor Pale Shade
巡礼者隆道尔的苍白影子.lore: A secretive assassin from Londor armed with paired claws.

黑手哥德希尔特.name: Black Hand Gotthard
黑手哥德希尔特.lore: Lothric's Black Hand meets his foes with paired straight swords.

狮子骑士艾伯特.name: Lion Knight Albert
狮子骑士艾伯特.lore: A warrior in lion armor who fights with a heavy axe.

绘画少女.name: Painter Girl
绘画少女.lore: She waits for pigment and flame to paint a new world.

拉普.name: Amnesiac Lapp
拉普.lore: A traveling knight of the Ringed City who has forgotten his past.

费莲诺尔的骑士希拉.name: Shira, Knight of Filianore
费莲诺尔的骑士希拉.lore: A knight of the Ringed City who serves the princess and watches over the dark dragon.

高墙游魂士兵.name: High Wall Hollow Soldier
高墙游魂士兵.lore: Lothric's masterless soldiers still guard the castle walls.

提灯游魂.name: Lantern Hollow
提灯游魂.lore: Its lantern calls fellow hollows to surround passing travelers.

人之脓.name: Pus of Man
人之脓.lore: A black, serpentine horror that bursts from a human body.

洛斯里克猎犬.name: Lothric Hound
洛斯里克猎犬.lore: A vicious hound that lunges and bites along the walls and through the settlement.

洛斯里克骑士.name: Lothric Knight
洛斯里克骑士.lore: A well-trained knight of the kingdom advances behind a shield.

洛斯里克长枪骑士.name: Lothric Spear Knight
洛斯里克长枪骑士.lore: This knight uses a long spear to deny passage from the front.

洛斯里克大剑骑士.name: Lothric Greatsword Knight
洛斯里克大剑骑士.lore: A heavily armored knight breaks defenses with a lightning-infused ultra greatsword.

羽翼骑士.name: Winged Knight
羽翼骑士.lore: A corpulent knight of the angelic faith swings a massive weapon.

金翼骑士.name: Ascended Winged Knight
金翼骑士.lore: A golden-armored guard protects the angelic faith high above the royal city.

传教士.name: Evangelist
传教士.lore: The settlement's hulking preacher catches travelers in a fiery embrace.

不死聚落农夫.name: Undead Settlement Worker
不死聚落农夫.lore: A cursed resident carrying a pitchfork or a heavy cleaver.

笼中亡者.name: Caged Hollow
笼中亡者.lore: Tangled corpses in an iron cage suddenly reach out to seize the unwary.

奴隶小恶魔.name: Thrall
奴隶小恶魔.lore: A small slave that waits in ambush on rooftops and around corners.

红眼锯手.name: Red-eyed Saw Worker
红眼锯手.lore: A red-eyed laborer drags a heavy saw through the settlement's streets.

背笼狂人.name: Cage-bearing Madman
背笼狂人.lore: A giant carrying a cage of corpses swings a heavy wooden plank.

鸦人说书者.name: Corvian Storyteller
鸦人说书者.lore: Poison mist and sorcery drive the Corvians along the road.

鸦人镰刀手.name: Corvian Scythebearer
鸦人镰刀手.lore: A birdlike figure suddenly leaps at travelers on the Road of Sacrifices.

十字架狼人.name: Lycanthrope
十字架狼人.lore: Once freed from its restraints, this maddened creature charges on all fours.

黑骑士大剑兵.name: Black Knight Greatswordsman
黑骑士大剑兵.lore: A black-armored knight hunts demons with a colossal blade.

黑骑士大斧兵.name: Black Knight Greataxe Warrior
黑骑士大斧兵.lore: A heavy battleaxe falls upon demons and intruders alike.

结晶蜥蜴幼体.name: Young Crystal Lizard
结晶蜥蜴幼体.lore: A gem-bearing little lizard that scurries into cracks in the wall.

贪食结晶蜥蜴.name: Ravenous Crystal Lizard
贪食结晶蜥蜴.lore: A great crystalline beast grown fat from devouring souls.

幽邃教堂执事.name: Cathedral Deacon
幽邃教堂执事.lore: Fireballs and prayers to the Deep defend the cathedral.

幽邃教堂骑士.name: Cathedral Knight
幽邃教堂骑士.lore: Heavy armor, great hammers, and greatswords seal off the narrow corridors.

幽邃教堂巨人.name: Cathedral Giant
幽邃教堂巨人.lore: A vast slave imprisoned in the cathedral's flooded hall.

大蛆人.name: Infested Corpse
大蛆人.lore: A maggot-infested corpse spreads corrupted blood through contact.

宝箱怪.name: Mimic
宝箱怪.lore: Disguised as a chest, it catches the greedy with unnaturally long limbs.

卡萨斯骷髅剑士.name: Carthus Skeleton Swordsman
卡萨斯骷髅剑士.lore: A nimble swordsman haunting the Catacombs of Carthus.

卡萨斯红眼剑士.name: Carthus Red-eyed Swordsman
卡萨斯红眼剑士.lore: Curved-blade strikes and rolling movement become a swift, unbroken assault.

卡萨斯大曲刀手.name: Carthus Great Curved Swordsman
卡萨斯大曲刀手.lore: A towering catacomb guardian deals bleeding combinations with a heavy curved blade.

卡萨斯车轮骷髅.name: Carthus Bonewheel Skeleton
卡萨斯车轮骷髅.lore: A spiked skeleton hurtles down the catacomb passages at great speed.

熏烟湖螃蟹.name: Smouldering Lake Crab
熏烟湖螃蟹.lore: A thick shell protects this inhabitant of the scorching lake.

恶魔遗迹咕噜.name: Demon Ruins Ghru
恶魔遗迹咕噜.lore: A beastlike inhabitant of the ruins of Chaos skilled with poisoned blades.

恶魔祭司.name: Demon Cleric
恶魔祭司.lore: Its ball of flame releases floating projectiles that pursue intruders.

墓地沙虫.name: Carthus Sandworm
墓地沙虫.lore: A giant worm erupts from beneath Smouldering Lake and spits lightning.

教宗骑士.name: Pontiff Knight
教宗骑士.lore: A curved-sword knight of the Boreal Valley delivers long, flowing combinations.

教宗火焰魔女.name: Fire Witch
教宗火焰魔女.lore: A burning brand and eruptions of ground fire guard the streets.

冷冽谷银骑士.name: Boreal Valley Silver Knight
冷冽谷银骑士.lore: Lightning-infused spears and straight swords defend the long royal stairway.

银骑士大弓兵.name: Silver Knight Greatbow Archer
银骑士大弓兵.lore: From the rooftops, great dragon-slaying arrows knock approaching foes away.

伊鲁席尔奴隶.name: Irithyll Slave
伊鲁席尔奴隶.lore: A gaunt, frost-shrouded servant vanishes before springing an ambush.

沙力万巨兽.name: Sulyvahn's Beast
沙力万巨兽.lore: A great, fanged beast guards the waterway with crushing bites and lightning breath.

狱卒.name: Jailer
狱卒.lore: A branding iron and an aura of terror drain the strength of prisoners.

婴儿脸爬行者.name: Wretch
婴儿脸爬行者.lore: A failed experiment with an infantlike face crawls along the dungeon walls.

罪之都石像鬼.name: Profaned Capital Gargoyle
罪之都石像鬼.lore: Stone guardians with long spears defend the old capital of the Profaned Flame.

罪之都手掌怪.name: Monstrosity of Sin
罪之都手掌怪.lore: A great hand-headed creature devours life in a crushing embrace.

古龙顶蛇人.name: Archdragon Peak Man-serpent
古龙顶蛇人.lore: Armed with curved swords and shields, these serpent-men follow the path of the dragon.

古龙顶蛇人大斧手.name: Man-serpent Greataxe Warrior
古龙顶蛇人大斧手.lore: A massive long-handled axe blocks the mountain path.

古龙顶召唤师.name: Man-serpent Summoner
古龙顶召唤师.lore: The ringing of its bell summons Drakeblood Knights and warriors of old.

岩石蜥蜴.name: Rock Lizard
岩石蜥蜴.lore: Rocky armor protects its body as it rolls into enemies.

艾雷德尔米尔伍德骑士.name: Ariandel Millwood Knight
艾雷德尔米尔伍德骑士.lore: A heavily armored forest warrior fights with a battleaxe and greatbow.

米尔伍德大弓骑士.name: Millwood Greatbow Knight
米尔伍德大弓骑士.lore: Great arrows blast the ground apart, destroying an enemy's footing.

鸦羽骑士.name: Crow Quill Knight
鸦羽骑士.lore: An aristocratic Corvian of the painting wields a thrusting sword and throwing blades.

鸦爪骑士.name: Crow Talon Knight
鸦爪骑士.lore: Huge crow claws carry this knight into a sudden, furious assault.

绘画树女.name: Painted Tree Woman
绘画树女.lore: A womanlike tree repels intruders with flame or freezing breath.

狼群.name: Painted World Wolf Pack
狼群.lore: Wolves of the painted snowfields call their companions to hunt together.

环印骑士直剑兵.name: Ringed Knight Swordsman
环印骑士直剑兵.lore: Ancient fire still burns within the armor of this Ringed Knight.

环印骑士双特大剑兵.name: Ringed Knight Paired Greatswordsman
环印骑士双特大剑兵.lore: An elite of the Ringed City swings a pair of burning ultra greatswords.

哈兰德战士.name: Harald Legion Knight
哈兰德战士.lore: A towering, hollowed warrior delivers crushing blows with a curved greatsword.

聚集于深渊的蝗虫.name: Locust Preacher
聚集于深渊的蝗虫.lore: An insectlike inhabitant praises the Abyss in the Ringed City's poisonous swamp.

巡礼天使.name: Pilgrim Angel
巡礼天使.lore: Its ceaseless beams are sustained by a pilgrim chrysalis hidden on the ground.

巡礼蝴蝶.name: Pilgrim Butterfly
巡礼蝴蝶.lore: It drifts above Lothric and controls the Dragonslayer Armour.

咒蛙.name: Dark Souls III Basilisk
咒蛙.lore: It exhales a curse-bearing mist from the depths of the wetland.

环印城墓碑亡者.name: Grave-bearing Hollow
环印城墓碑亡者.lore: Hollows burdened with gravestones emerge from the shadows of the Ringed City's streets.

巨人判官.name: Judicator Giant
巨人判官.lore: It summons spectral archers and knights to protect the Ringed City.

哈维尔战士.name: Havel Warrior
哈维尔战士.lore: The rock-armored warrior of Archdragon Peak blocks the way with a Dragon Tooth and greatshield.

彼海姆的文海姆.name: Sir Vilhelm
彼海姆的文海姆.lore: A silent knight with a black greatsword guards the attic of the painting.

教会野兽.name: Cleric Beast
教会野兽.lore: A towering, beast-transformed cleric on the bridge pressures nearby prey with sweeping claws.

加斯科因.name: Father Gascoigne
加斯科因.lore: This hunter transforms into a beast as battle rages, his gun and axe keeping up relentless pressure.

梅尔戈乳母.name: Mergo's Wet Nurse
梅尔戈乳母.lore: Many curved blades close off her prey's escape from every direction.

渴血兽.name: Blood-starved Beast
渴血兽.lore: A flayed beast relentlessly pursues hunters with poisonous blood and pouncing attacks.

阿梅利亚.name: Vicar Amelia
阿梅利亚.lore: The vicar of the Grand Cathedral restores her life through prayer.

汉威克女巫.name: Witch of Hemwick
汉威克女巫.lore: She hides herself to cast spells and summon scythe-bearing Mad Ones.

雅南暗影.name: Shadows of Yharnam
雅南暗影.lore: Three guardians cover one another with blades, fireballs, and candle flame.

罗姆.name: Rom, the Vacuous Spider
罗姆.lore: The vacuous spider calls down arcane meteors while smaller spiders protect her.

黑兽帕尔.name: Darkbeast Paarl
黑兽帕尔.lore: Lightning coils around its skeletal frame, and charged discharges drive nearby foes away.

重生之古神.name: The One Reborn
重生之古神.lore: A colossal mass of corpses spews foul, corrosive fluids.

米克拉什.name: Micolash, Host of the Nightmare
米克拉什.lore: The nightmare's host flees through endless passages and attacks with arcane tentacles.

星之使者.name: Celestial Emissary
星之使者.lore: This kin reveals its enormous true form from within the crowd.

伊布莱塔斯.name: Ebrietas, Daughter of the Cosmos
伊布莱塔斯.lore: She fights with tentacles, rushing attacks, and the arcane light of the stars.

格曼.name: Gehrman, the First Hunter
格曼.lore: The first hunter combines the Burial Blade with swift, deadly footwork.

月之魔物.name: Moon Presence
月之魔物.lore: The Great One descending into the dream can reduce a hunter's life to almost nothing.

路德维希.name: Ludwig, the Accursed
路德维希.lore: The cursed, beast-shaped knight finally raises the Holy Moonlight Sword.

劳伦斯.name: Laurence, the First Vicar
劳伦斯.lore: The first vicar's beastly body is consumed by flame and lava; those who strike him up close are burned in return.

活体失败者.name: Living Failures
活体失败者.lore: The failed experiments of the Research Hall together summon meteors from the cosmos.

玛丽亚.name: Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower
玛丽亚.lore: The hunter of the Astral Clocktower fights with paired blades and burning blood.

科斯孤儿.name: Orphan of Kos
科斯孤儿.lore: It charges ferociously with its placenta weapon and calls lightning down upon the coast.

苏美鲁女王雅南.name: Yharnam, Pthumerian Queen
苏美鲁女王雅南.lore: Deep in the chalices, the queen defeats intruders with blood blades and doubles.

苏美鲁后裔.name: Pthumerian Descendant
苏美鲁后裔.lore: An ancient guardian with paired curved blades pursues intruders in rapid combinations.

苏美鲁长老.name: Pthumerian Elder
苏美鲁长老.lore: An ancient sorcerer turns his staff into a succession of fiery weapons.

不死巨人.name: Undead Giant
不死巨人.lore: This chalice giant sweeps its surroundings with scythes, heavy hammers, or chains.

放血兽.name: Bloodletting Beast
放血兽.lore: A towering, skinless beast overwhelms opponents with long arms and trampling feet.

无头放血兽.name: Headless Bloodletting Beast
无头放血兽.lore: A parasite within its severed neck sprays venom.

旧主看门狗.name: Watchdog of the Old Lords
旧主看门狗.lore: The burning hound leaves trails of flame after its charges.

洛伦黑暗怪兽.name: Loran Darkbeast
洛伦黑暗怪兽.lore: A skeletal monster deep in Loran unleashes unceasing lightning.

被遗忘的疯子.name: Forgotten Madman
被遗忘的疯子.lore: A tomb hunter driven mad fights with arcane arts and close-combat weapons.

野兽附身的灵魂.name: Beast-possessed Soul
野兽附身的灵魂.lore: A soul consumed by beasthood attacks intruders with flame.

脑噬者.name: Brainsucker
脑噬者.lore: This kin binds hunters with arcane power and drains their Insight.

人偶.name: The Doll
人偶.lore: In the dream, she helps hunters turn Blood Echoes into strength.

吉尔伯特.name: Gilbert
吉尔伯特.lore: A sick man behind a window offers help to a hunter newly arrived in Yharnam.

亚莉安娜.name: Arianna
亚莉安娜.lore: A woman of the Cathedral Ward who offers her distinctive blood.

阿黛拉.name: Adella
阿黛拉.lore: A nun of the Healing Church who helps hunters with her special blood.

欧顿小教堂居民.name: Oedon Chapel Dweller
欧顿小教堂居民.lore: The keeper of the chapel tends its refuge for survivors.

孤独老妇人.name: Lonely Old Woman
孤独老妇人.lore: After taking shelter in the chapel, she offers sedatives to the hunter.

加斯科因的小女儿.name: Gascoigne's Younger Daughter
加斯科因的小女儿.lore: She entrusts a music box to a stranger through her window and waits for her family to return.

小女孩的姐姐.name: Young Girl's Older Sister
小女孩的姐姐.lore: A girl at the window claims to be the child's sister and seeks the ribbon her sister left behind.

约瑟夫卡.name: Iosefka
约瑟夫卡.lore: The clinic's doctor provides special blood vials for healing.

冒牌约瑟夫卡.name: Impostor Iosefka
冒牌约瑟夫卡.lore: The researcher who seized the clinic transforms those seeking help into kin.

艾琳.name: Eileen the Crow
艾琳.lore: The crow hunter pursues fellow hunters who have become drunk with blood.

杜拉.name: Djura
杜拉.lore: The hunter of Old Yharnam uses his gatling gun to protect its beastly inhabitants.

阿尔弗雷德.name: Alfred
阿尔弗雷德.lore: A devotee of the Executioners who hunts Cainhurst's Vilebloods with heavy weapons.

亨利克.name: Henryk
亨利克.lore: A veteran hunter clad in yellow garb resistant to lightning.

瓦尔特.name: Valtr, Master of the League
瓦尔特.lore: With a broken saw, the League's master purges the impurity he sees in others.

安娜莉丝.name: Annalise, Queen of the Vilebloods
安娜莉丝.lore: The undying queen gathers Blood Dregs as she awaits a Child of Blood.

西蒙.name: Simon the Harrowed
西蒙.lore: An old hunter with a bowblade investigates the Hunter's Nightmare.

布拉多.name: Brador
布拉多.lore: A Church assassin clad in beast hide bars visitors with the Bloodletter.

圣女阿德琳.name: Saint Adeline
圣女阿德琳.lore: A patient of the Research Hall craves Brain Fluid and hears the voice of the stars.

可疑乞丐.name: Suspicious Beggar
可疑乞丐.lore: A cannibal posing as a survivor conceals his beastly form.

蜘蛛帕奇.name: Patches the Spider
蜘蛛帕奇.lore: With treasure as bait, he pushes hunters into danger.

老猎人亨利特.name: Old Hunter Henriett
老猎人亨利特.lore: An old hunter wielding the Kirkhammer offers aid against the Grand Cathedral's guardian.

双胞胎弟弟马达拉斯.name: Younger Madaras Twin
双胞胎弟弟马达拉斯.lore: A League hunter armed with a butcher's knife and a great serpent's whistle.

亚楠市民.name: Yharnam Huntsman
亚楠市民.lore: The beast-stricken inhabitants of Yharnam still swing their farming tools.

持枪市民.name: Rifle Huntsman
持枪市民.lore: A huntsman at the rear supports his companions with gunfire.

持盾市民.name: Shield Huntsman
持盾市民.lore: A makeshift shield blocks light attacks from the front.

猎犬.name: Hunting Dog
猎犬.lore: Packs of hunting dogs swiftly pounce on exposed prey.

亚楠乌鸦.name: Carrion Crow
亚楠乌鸦.lore: A carrion crow that has lost flight pecks and lunges along the ground.

老鼠群.name: Labyrinth Rat Swarm
老鼠群.lore: Rats of the tombs surround their prey with overwhelming numbers.

教会仆从.name: Church Servant
教会仆从.lore: A pale servant of the Church carries a lantern and a cane.

研究大厅患者.name: Research Hall Patient
研究大厅患者.lore: An experimental patient with a swollen head wanders through the Research Hall.

持火暴徒.name: Torch-bearing Huntsman
持火暴徒.lore: Yharnam's mobs raise torches and firebombs to hunt outsiders.

兽化病患.name: Beast Patient
兽化病患.lore: An afflicted inhabitant of Old Yharnam lunges at hunters with repeated claw attacks.

小天界使者.name: Small Celestial Emissary
小天界使者.lore: A blue kin that fires arcane projectiles from afar.

血虱.name: Bloodlicker
血虱.lore: A bloated blood-drinking creature attacks with long limbs and sprays of blood.

小蛇球.name: Small Snake Ball
小蛇球.lore: A knot of intertwined snakes spits poisonous fluid.

巨蛇球.name: Giant Snake Ball
巨蛇球.lore: The forest's tangled masses of great serpents spew venom without pause.

砖块巨人.name: Brick Troll
砖块巨人.lore: A gigantic huntsman delivers slow but crushing punches with a brick.

斧头巨人.name: Executioner
斧头巨人.lore: A hulking, cloaked executioner sweeps his axe through everything before him.

教会巨人.name: Church Giant
教会巨人.lore: An enormous Church servant fights with a great axe or an iron ball.

教会十字架仆从.name: Church Crucifix Servant
教会十字架仆从.lore: A servant wielding a wooden crucifix threatens nearby foes with heavy blows and frenzy.

狼人.name: Scourge Beast
狼人.lore: A werewolf overwhelms isolated hunters with swift claw attacks.

摇铃女.name: Bell-ringing Woman
摇铃女.lore: The ringing of her bell summons enemies and red phantoms.

冬灯.name: Winter Lantern
冬灯.lore: The gaze of this singing, malformed creature alone can induce frenzy.

曼希斯之脑.name: Brain of Mensis
曼希斯之脑.lore: The giant brain suspended in the Nightmare of Mensis builds frenzy in those it watches.

食人猪.name: Maneater Boar
食人猪.lore: An enormous, swollen boar charges at prey trapped on narrow paths.

该隐赫斯特血鸦.name: Bloody Crow of Cainhurst
该隐赫斯特血鸦.lore: A Vileblood hunter in crow garb wields the Chikage with deadly skill.

巨型鱼人.name: Shark-Giant
巨型鱼人.lore: A fishing hamlet giant overwhelms hunters with an anchor and vicious lunges.

渔村鱼人.name: Fishing Hamlet Villager
渔村鱼人.lore: Altered by a Great One, the hamlet's inhabitants fight with harpoons and long spears.

鱼人祭司.name: Fishman Priest
鱼人祭司.lore: A priest of the fishing hamlet calls down arcane attacks from afar.

脑液.name: Brain Fluid
脑液.lore: Living brain tissue left behind by failed experiments in the Research Hall.

石像鬼.name: Cainhurst Gargoyle
石像鬼.lore: The stone creatures of Cainhurst suddenly spread their wings and dive at intruders.

该隐赫斯特女幽灵.name: Cainhurst Noblewoman Ghost
该隐赫斯特女幽灵.lore: The castle's silent noblewomen slash at outsiders without warning.

苏美鲁守卫.name: Pthumerian Watcher
苏美鲁守卫.lore: Ancient guardians of the chalice tombs repel intruders with great blades, clubs, or firearms.

苏美鲁守墓人.name: Keeper of the Old Lords
苏美鲁守墓人.lore: A pointed-helmed tomb guardian fights with heavy, fiery weapons.

墓穴蜘蛛.name: Tomb Spider
墓穴蜘蛛.lore: Spiders emerge in swarms from the shadows of the chalice tombs.

迷宫狂人.name: Labyrinth Madman
迷宫狂人.lore: A tomb madman wielding corpses attacks in a blinding charge.

墓犬.name: Tomb Hound
墓犬.lore: The tomb hound brings dark-aligned attacks to sacrifice-based battles.

教会猎人.name: Church Hunter
教会猎人.lore: The Church hunter brings physical attacks to sacrifice-based battles.

蛛形怪.name: Spider Beast
蛛形怪.lore: The spider beast brings dark-aligned attacks to sacrifice-based battles.

触手兽.name: Tentacled Beast
触手兽.lore: The tentacled beast brings dark-aligned attacks to sacrifice-based battles.

狼.name: Wolf
狼.lore: The Shinobi Prosthetic and lethal sword arts let this shinobi adapt swiftly across the battle line.

鬼刑部.name: Gyoubu Masataka Oniwa
鬼刑部.lore: The mounted samurai seals off the castle gate battlefield with his long spear.

蝴蝶夫人.name: Lady Butterfly
蝴蝶夫人.lore: An illusionist shinobi uses threads and phantom doubles to disrupt the battle.

弦一郎.name: Genichiro Ashina
弦一郎.lore: An Ashina swordsman combines archery, lightning, and relentless sword combinations.

屏风猿猴.name: Folding Screen Monkeys
屏风猿猴.lore: The monkeys of sight, hearing, speech, and invisibility test perception and evasion.

狮子猿.name: Guardian Ape
狮子猿.lore: The immortal ape rises even after losing its head, now wielding a sword.

无首狮子猿.name: Headless Ape
无首狮子猿.lore: The beheaded ape guards its cavern with terrifying cries and sword strikes.

破戒僧.name: Corrupted Monk
破戒僧.lore: The naginata-wielding monk's illusion blocks Mibu Village with sweeping, spinning cuts.

宫内破戒僧.name: True Corrupted Monk
宫内破戒僧.lore: The bridge guardian is bound to an immortal centipede.

枭.name: Great Shinobi Owl
枭.lore: The old shinobi hinders opponents with smoke, poison, and healing-blocking medicine.

义父.name: Owl (Father)
义父.lore: Owl at his peak repositions himself with the help of a phantom owl.

一心.name: Isshin, the Sword Saint
一心.lore: The Sword Saint's fighting style combines spear, sword, and lightning.

怨恨之鬼.name: Demon of Hatred
怨恨之鬼.lore: Accumulated hatred takes the shape of a gigantic, burning Shura.

神龙.name: Divine Dragon
神龙.lore: The Sakura Dragon raises storms with a seven-branched sword; reflected lightning can break its defense.

艾玛.name: Emma, the Gentle Blade
艾玛.lore: The physician Emma helps Wolf treat Dragonrot, then draws her gentle blade to stop his fall into Shura.

侍大将河原田直盛.name: General Naomori Kawarada
侍大将河原田直盛.lore: The general guarding the outskirts fights with a long blade and sweeping cuts.

侍大将山内典膳.name: General Tenzen Yamauchi
侍大将山内典膳.lore: The general at the outskirts checkpoint meets enemies with thrusts and sweeping attacks.

侍大将松本内藏佑.name: General Kuranosuke Matsumoto
侍大将松本内藏佑.lore: Riflemen protect the general on the castle keep's stairs.

苇名七本枪山内式部利胜.name: Seven Ashina Spears - Shikibu Toshikatsu Yamauchi
苇名七本枪山内式部利胜.lore: An honored Ashina retainer fights with long-spear thrusts and wide, sweeping attacks.

苇名七本枪鬼庭主马雅次.name: Seven Ashina Spears - Shume Masaji Oniwa
苇名七本枪鬼庭主马雅次.lore: A master spearman still holds his position within the burning Ashina Castle.

苇名流佐濑甚助.name: Ashina Elite - Jinsuke Saze
苇名流佐濑甚助.lore: The swordsman in the dojo specializes in lightning-fast Ashina Cross draws.

水生氏成.name: Ujinari Mizuo
水生氏成.lore: A red-eyed swordsman of Ashina Castle uses swift cross-draw attacks but fears flame.

赤鬼.name: Chained Ogre
赤鬼.lore: The restrained, red-eyed giant excels at crushing grabs but fears fire.

蚺蛇重藏.name: Juzou the Drunkard
蚺蛇重藏.lore: A huge, hard-drinking bandit exhales clouds of poison.

牛饮德次郎.name: Tokujiro the Glutton
牛饮德次郎.lore: This drunken forest brute bars the road with a great blade and poisonous breath.

赤备重吉.name: Shigekichi of the Red Guard
赤备重吉.lore: A heavily armored Red Guard warrior breathes flame and swings a heavy blade.

火牛.name: Blazing Bull
火牛.lore: With burning timber lashed to its horns, the bull charges in a frenzy.

宫之樱牛.name: Sakura Bull of the Palace
宫之樱牛.lore: The great bull of Fountainhead Palace charges beneath horns shedding cherry blossoms.

铠甲武士.name: Armored Warrior
铠甲武士.lore: Blades scarcely harm the bridge's armored warrior; victory requires forcing him over the edge.

长爪蜈蚣仙云.name: Long-arm Centipede Sen-un
长爪蜈蚣仙云.lore: The claw-bladed fighter of Senpou Temple unleashes dense, relentless combinations.

长爪蜈蚣峰云.name: Long-arm Centipede Giraffe
长爪蜈蚣峰云.lore: The claw-bladed fighter inside the Gun Fort blocks the passage.

蛇眼白藤.name: Snake Eyes Shirafuji
蛇眼白藤.lore: The sniper before the Gun Fort fights with a firearm and a deadly hooking grab.

蛇眼白萩.name: Snake Eyes Shirahagi
蛇眼白萩.lore: The Snake Eyes guard of the poisonous swamp can fight on tainted ground without pause.

孤影众太刀足.name: Lone Shadow Longswordsman
孤影众太刀足.lore: The shinobi at the bottom of the well combines fierce kicks with swordplay.

孤影众忌手.name: Lone Shadow Vilehand
孤影众忌手.lore: This Lone Shadow weakens opponents with combinations of poisoned hand strikes.

孤影众枪足之正长.name: Lone Shadow Masanaga the Spear-Bearer
孤影众枪足之正长.lore: A Lone Shadow skilled in kicking arts whistles for ninja hounds.

雾隐贵人.name: Mist Noble
雾隐贵人.lore: The noble hidden in a ruined house sustains the forest's illusions.

无首.name: Headless
无首.lore: A headless apparition swings a heavy blade and drives approaching foes away with terror.

七面武士.name: Shichimen Warrior
七面武士.lore: A vengeful spirit attacks with departed souls and beams of cursed light.

淤加美长老静.name: Okami Leader Shizu
淤加美长老静.lore: The elder of Fountainhead Palace seals off the lake with lightning-charged kemari kicks.

白蛇.name: Great Serpent
白蛇.lore: The great white serpent of the valley drives intruders away with sudden, swift strikes.

鱼王.name: Great Colored Carp
鱼王.lore: The enormous carp beneath Fountainhead Palace's lake defends its territory with crushing charges.

九郎.name: Kuro, the Divine Heir
九郎.lore: The Divine Heir seeks to sever immortality and gives Wolf the will to continue.

变若之子.name: Divine Child of Rejuvenation
变若之子.lore: The girl of Senpou Temple offers rice to help travelers.

黑笠之貉.name: Blackhat Badger
黑笠之貉.lore: A shinobi who left Senpou Temple helps Wolf reach its hidden depths.

穴山.name: Anayama the Peddler
穴山.lore: The merchant gathers information and supplies Wolf with provisions.

藤冈.name: Fujioka the Info Broker
藤冈.lore: An information broker who sets up shop at the Dilapidated Temple.

小太郎.name: Kotaro
小太郎.lore: The innocent giant longs to find a pure white pinwheel.

阵左卫门.name: Jinzaemon Kumano
阵左卫门.lore: A samurai follows the sound of a shamisen into Mibu Village.

伊之介.name: Inosuke Nogami
伊之介.lore: The wounded samurai of Hirata Estate offers a clue to protecting the young lord.

野上玄斋.name: Nogami Gensai
野上玄斋.lore: A samurai of Hirata Estate willing to help challenge Juzou.

雕刻师.name: The Sculptor
雕刻师.lore: The one-armed shinobi carves Buddha statues and maintains Wolf's Shinobi Prosthetic.

道顺.name: Doujun
道顺.lore: The dungeon physician experiments with turning people into red-eyed subjects.

道玄.name: Dogen
道玄.lore: The physician who created the Shinobi Prosthetic left techniques that reshape combat.

不死半兵卫.name: Hanbei the Undying
不死半兵卫.lore: The samurai who cannot die helps Wolf practice swordplay at the temple.

坛子贵人春长.name: Pot Noble Harunaga
坛子贵人春长.lore: He collects Treasure Carp Scales from Wolf and sells precious goods.

坛子贵人维盛.name: Pot Noble Koremori
坛子贵人维盛.lore: The noble in a pot at Fountainhead Palace longs to become the Great Carp.

供养众.name: Memorial Mob
供养众.lore: A merchant in dangerous country sells supplies to passing shinobi.

苇名足轻.name: Ashina Foot Soldier
苇名足轻.lore: An Ashina soldier with ordinary blades and spears guards the outskirts.

苇名弓兵.name: Ashina Archer
苇名弓兵.lore: An archer supports companions on the front line.

苇名火枪兵.name: Ashina Rifleman
苇名火枪兵.lore: A rifleman uses high ground to maintain steady fire.

苇名农夫.name: Ashina Farmer
苇名农夫.lore: A farmer uses crude tools to resist intruders.

山贼.name: Hirata Bandit
山贼.lore: A bandit of Hirata Estate pillages with a short blade and spear.

持盾山贼.name: Shield Bandit
持盾山贼.lore: A sturdy wooden shield blocks frontal attacks but is vulnerable to an axe.

苇名长枪兵.name: Ashina Spearman
苇名长枪兵.lore: A spearman's thrusts keep enemies at a distance.

野犬.name: Wild Hound
野犬.lore: Agile packs of dogs pursue shinobi traveling the roads.

猴群.name: Monkey Troop
猴群.lore: Monkeys of the Bodhisattva Valley harass enemies by throwing stones.

持枪猴.name: Rifle Monkey
持枪猴.lore: A monkey of the valley raises a firearm and shoots.

水生村民.name: Mibu Villager
水生村民.lore: Villagers touched by immortality gather in ever greater numbers.

源之宫贵人.name: Fountainhead Noble
源之宫贵人.lore: An aged noble plays a flute to steal the vitality of those who approach.

壁虎.name: Gecko
壁虎.lore: Hidden on cliff walls and inside houses, it spits poison at passersby.

火把山贼.name: Torch Bandit
火把山贼.lore: A bandit brandishing a torch drives foes back with flame.

持炮山贼.name: Cannon Bandit
持炮山贼.lore: A bandit with a shoulder-mounted cannon delivers powerful blows from afar.

孤影众.name: Lone Shadow Shinobi
孤影众.lore: An Interior Ministry shinobi fights with a blade, powerful kicks, and agile movement.

仙峰僧.name: Senpou Monk
仙峰僧.lore: A monk of Senpou Temple uses fists and feet to deflect blades.

斗笠双刃僧.name: Senpou Battle Monk
斗笠双刃僧.lore: An elite monk in a woven hat leaps into combat with a double-ended naginata.

附虫者.name: Infested Monk
附虫者.lore: A centipede-infested monk rises again after being struck down.

白猿剑客.name: White Monkey Swordsman
白猿剑客.lore: A white-furred monkey wields paired swords with far greater ferocity than an ordinary troop.

赤备兵.name: Red Guard Soldier
赤备兵.lore: An elite of the Interior Ministry wears red armor and attacks with paired blades or a firearm.

巨型公鸡.name: Giant Rooster
巨型公鸡.lore: The roadside rooster attacks with fierce pecks and flapping wings.

淤加美武者.name: Okami Warrior
淤加美武者.lore: An agile warrior of Fountainhead Palace defends it with leaping movement and lightning techniques.

淤加美弓手.name: Okami Archer
淤加美弓手.lore: An archer of Fountainhead Palace channels lightning into arrows.

淤加美蹴鞠手.name: Okami Kemari Player
淤加美蹴鞠手.lore: A succession of kicked kemari balls strikes distant targets.

太郎兵.name: Taro Troop Brute
太郎兵.lore: A gigantic soldier overwhelms foes with a wooden mallet or bell clapper.

地牢囚徒.name: Dungeon Prisoner
地牢囚徒.lore: A prisoner bereft of reason wanders through the Abandoned Dungeon.

水生阿凛.name: O'Rin of the Water
水生阿凛.lore: The shamisen-playing spirit asks after Lord Sakuza as she fights with drifting steps and flowing sword dances.

七本枪.name: Seven Ashina Spears
七本枪.lore: This spearfighter brings physical attacks to sacrifice-based battles.

苇名武士.name: Ashina Samurai
苇名武士.lore: The Ashina samurai brings physical attacks to sacrifice-based battles.

忍者.name: Shinobi
忍者.lore: The shinobi brings physical attacks to sacrifice-based battles.

盖尔·金辉.name: Gilded Slave Knight Gael
盖尔·金辉.lore: The old knight crossed countless battlefields, stitching the resolve of the fallen into his bloodstained cloak.

深渊守望者·金辉.name: Gilded Abyss Watchers
深渊守望者·金辉.lore: Wolf blood renews its covenant in golden embers; fallen swordsmen leave their final round of cuts to their companions.

冷冽谷的玻尔多·金辉.name: Gilded Vordt of the Boreal Valley
冷冽谷的玻尔多·金辉.lore: Icy gold coats the beastly armor as its low, stalking steps pursue warm life through the frozen mist.

教宗沙力万·金辉.name: Gilded Pontiff Sulyvahn
教宗沙力万·金辉.lore: Twin swords cleave golden shadows; the Pontiff leaves his unfinished orders to a mirror image, and the final cuts keep closing in.

薪王们的化身·金辉.name: Gilded Soul of Cinder
薪王们的化身·金辉.lore: All who linked the fire entrust their golden kindling to one suit of armor; as one sword style burns away, another memory rises.

黑龙米狄尔·金辉.name: Gilded Darkeater Midir
黑龙米狄尔·金辉.lore: Golden scales still gleam within the Abyss; the ancient dragon that swallowed ages of darkness leaves one last blast for intruders.

灰烬审判者古达·金辉.name: Gilded Iudex Gundyr
灰烬审判者古达·金辉.lore: The withdrawn coiled sword leaves a golden fissure; the silent judge once more awaits the Undead.

结晶老者·金辉.name: Gilded Crystal Sage
结晶老者·金辉.lore: Crystals scatter layer upon layer of golden light, each afterimage whispering the next incantation.

幽邃主教群·金辉.name: Gilded Deacons of the Deep
幽邃主教群·金辉.lore: Golden candles light decaying vestments, while prayers to the Deep drift from behind the gathered faces.

霸王沃尼尔·金辉.name: Gilded High Lord Wolnir
霸王沃尼尔·金辉.lore: Golden bracelets shine at the edge of the Abyss; he clutches not at a crown, but at the last thread of light.

巨人尤姆·金辉.name: Gilded Yhorm the Giant
巨人尤姆·金辉.lore: Golden light passes over the great blade amid the storm; the lonely king still fights for those he could not save.

冷冽谷的舞娘·金辉.name: Gilded Dancer of the Boreal Valley
冷冽谷的舞娘·金辉.lore: One blade of fire, one of dark; gold follows every measured step, and only when the music ends do the blades arrive.

猎龙铠甲·金辉.name: Gilded Dragonslayer Armour
猎龙铠甲·金辉.lore: Empty armor wears a golden sheen, while its ancient lightning axe still remembers the duty of slaying dragons.

洛斯里克王子·金辉.name: Gilded Lothric, Younger Prince
洛斯里克王子·金辉.lore: The frail prince binds his brother's soul with golden light; neither will awaken to link the fire again.

无名王者·金辉.name: Gilded Nameless King
无名王者·金辉.lore: Storm and lightning forge a golden spear, and the forgotten god's name still echoes beside his dragon.

修女芙莉德·金辉.name: Gilded Sister Friede
修女芙莉德·金辉.lore: Gold glints across frost blades and black flame; the spent painting still refuses the arrival of a new color.

格曼·金辉.name: Gilded Gehrman, the First Hunter
格曼·金辉.lore: The first hunter leaves his final hunting notes, hoping those who awaken need not face the long night alone.

加斯科因·金辉.name: Gilded Father Gascoigne
加斯科因·金辉.lore: A faint gold shines along the old hunter's axe; steps not yet consumed by beasthood still remember how to meet the prey.

科斯孤儿·金辉.name: Gilded Orphan of Kos
科斯孤儿·金辉.lore: Coastal lightning lights the golden remnant of birth; every furious rush hurls an unheard answer back at the world.

教会野兽·金辉.name: Gilded Cleric Beast
教会野兽·金辉.lore: Golden fragments catch among twisted antlers; the roar upon the bridge still tears a hunter's courage in two.

路德维希·金辉.name: Gilded Ludwig, the Accursed
路德维希·金辉.lore: Gold reveals broken beast bones and the holy blade of old; a hunter's unextinguished spark endures within the mad charge.

玛丽亚·金辉.name: Gilded Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower
玛丽亚·金辉.lore: Blood becomes golden thread between paired blades; with every kill, the clocktower's guardian pursues a past no one can redeem.

渴血兽·金辉.name: Gilded Blood-starved Beast
渴血兽·金辉.lore: Thirst churns beneath its gilded hide; the scent of blood rouses it more surely than any bell.

阿梅利亚·金辉.name: Gilded Vicar Amelia
阿梅利亚·金辉.lore: A golden pendant rests between great claws; the prayer has not ended, but has taken on a beast's voice.

汉威克女巫·金辉.name: Gilded Witch of Hemwick
汉威克女巫·金辉.lore: Gold glimmers through hidden eyes; whoever sees the witch clearly has also been seen by her.

雅南暗影·金辉.name: Gilded Shadows of Yharnam
雅南暗影·金辉.lore: Candle flame, serpent shadows, and blades overlap in gold; the three gatekeepers wait for a single misplaced step.

罗姆·金辉.name: Gilded Rom, the Vacuous Spider
罗姆·金辉.lore: The silent spider keeps watch over the lake in golden light, while the truth lies beneath moonlight you have yet to see.

重生之古神·金辉.name: Gilded The One Reborn
重生之古神·金辉.lore: Bells raise a gilded mass of remains; even this crude rite still hopes to lift humanity to the height of gods.

米克拉什·金辉.name: Gilded Micolash, Host of the Nightmare
米克拉什·金辉.lore: His golden cage pursues the answers of a dream; his feet move far faster than his understanding.

梅尔戈乳母·金辉.name: Gilded Mergo's Wet Nurse
梅尔戈乳母·金辉.lore: Six blades unfold silently in gold, while a child's cries remain hidden within a pitch-black embrace.

月之魔物·金辉.name: Gilded Moon Presence
月之魔物·金辉.lore: The crimson moon takes on a golden glow; its outstretched hand seems a blessing, or the reclaiming of all freedom.

劳伦斯·金辉.name: Gilded Laurence, the First Vicar
劳伦斯·金辉.lore: Golden flames burn through the earliest teachings; the first vicar still searches for his lost human skull.

鬼刑部·金辉.name: Gilded Gyoubu Masataka Oniwa
鬼刑部·金辉.lore: Golden dust settles on the warhorse before the gate; one sweep of the spear forces every challenger from his path.

蝴蝶夫人·金辉.name: Gilded Lady Butterfly
蝴蝶夫人·金辉.lore: Golden threads move true and false figures alike; when the phantom butterflies fade, two secret pages remain to break the deadlock.

一心·金辉.name: Gilded Isshin, the Sword Saint
一心·金辉.lore: The Sword Saint takes half a step into golden light, his blade answering every hesitation and probing strike.

弦一郎·金辉.name: Gilded Genichiro Ashina
弦一郎·金辉.lore: Ashina's lightning lingers on a golden edge; with even one breath left, he will fight for another inch of his homeland.

狮子猿·金辉.name: Gilded Guardian Ape
狮子猿·金辉.lore: Golden spray rolls down white fur; even fallen, the great ape clutches a blade and a resolve that will not end.

怨恨之鬼·金辉.name: Gilded Demon of Hatred
怨恨之鬼·金辉.lore: Golden fire binds the hatred that could not be released; Shura shatters the earth, burning every pain into a heavier blow.

赤鬼·金辉.name: Gilded Chained Ogre
赤鬼·金辉.lore: Gold shines in red eyes; once its chains break, its embrace is deadlier than any blade.

火牛·金辉.name: Gilded Blazing Bull
火牛·金辉.lore: Burning horns trail golden fire; no shield wall at Ashina's gate can halt its charge.

屏风猿猴·金辉.name: Gilded Folding Screen Monkeys
屏风猿猴·金辉.lore: Gold moves among seeing, hearing, speaking, and silence; the final monkey is always where you cannot look.

无首狮子猿·金辉.name: Gilded Headless Ape
无首狮子猿·金辉.lore: Gold lights the severed neck; the immortal insect still drives the ape to swing its long-bloodied blade.

破戒僧·金辉.name: Gilded Corrupted Monk
破戒僧·金辉.lore: The phantom raises a naginata in golden light; her lingering laughter is colder than the wind upon the bridge.

枭·金辉.name: Gilded Great Shinobi Owl
枭·金辉.lore: A vast feathered shadow obscures the gold; the shinobi code has never contained a word about fairness.

宫内破戒僧·金辉.name: Gilded True Corrupted Monk
宫内破戒僧·金辉.lore: The immortal insect gleams with gold as Fountainhead Palace's bridge guardian raises her long blade to greet another visitor.

神龙·金辉.name: Gilded Divine Dragon
神龙·金辉.lore: Withered branches sprout golden light; the wind called by the seven-branched sword still awaits returning lightning.

艾玛·金辉.name: Gilded Emma, the Gentle Blade
艾玛·金辉.lore: The scent of golden medicine lingers before the blade; even a gentle doctor may have to cut down Shura with her own hands.

义父·金辉.name: Gilded Owl (Father)
义父·金辉.lore: A ghostly blue owl crosses the golden light; at last, the father has found his child strong enough.

玛尔基特.name: Margit, the Fell Omen
玛尔基特.lore: Wields a cursed sword and spectral holy weapons to hold back Tarnished approaching the capital.

葛瑞克.name: Godrick the Grafted
葛瑞克.lore: The grafted lord meets his challengers with a great axe and a multitude of stolen arms.

蕾娜拉.name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
蕾娜拉.lore: The queen of the full moon fights with Carian sorcery and summoned spirits.

拉塔恩.name: Starscourge Radahn
拉塔恩.lore: The Starscourge General commands gravity magic and a pair of colossal swords.

拉卡德.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
拉卡德.lore: The blasphemous lord has joined with a great serpent and makes his lair amid molten rock.

莫格.name: Mohg, Lord of Blood
莫格.lore: The Lord of Blood drains life through rituals of bloodflame.

蒙葛特.name: Morgott, the Omen King
蒙葛特.lore: The Omen King guards the Erdtree with a curved sword and weapons of holy light.

火焰巨人.name: Fire Giant
火焰巨人.lore: Confronts his enemies with a vast shield and the flame of the one-eyed god.

玛利喀斯.name: Maliketh, the Black Blade
玛利喀斯.lore: His Black Blade bears Destined Death; relentless leaping strikes leave no time to breathe.

荷莱·露.name: Hoarah Loux
荷莱·露.lore: Casts aside the bearing of a lord to fight with crushing grapples and earth-shaking stomps.

葛孚雷.name: Godfrey, First Elden Lord
葛孚雷.lore: The first Elden Lord shakes the earth with his great axe.

拉达冈.name: Radagon of the Golden Order
拉达冈.lore: The restorer of the Golden Order punishes his foes with a sacred hammer and flashes of light.

艾尔登之兽.name: Elden Beast
艾尔登之兽.lore: The embodiment of the Golden Order blankets the battlefield in showers of holy stars.

玛莲妮亚.name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
玛莲妮亚.lore: Miquella's blade is renowned for her Waterfowl Dance and the bloom of scarlet rot.

米凯拉.name: Miquella
米凯拉.lore: The slumbering Empyrean guides his followers through enchantment and grace.

黄金树守卫.name: Tree Sentinel
黄金树守卫.lore: A heavily armored golden rider patrols with halberd and shield.

龙装大树守卫.name: Draconic Tree Sentinel
龙装大树守卫.lore: The armored rider before the capital's gate strengthens his weapon with red lightning.

恶兆妖鬼蒙格.name: Mohg, the Omen
恶兆妖鬼蒙格.lore: The Omen beneath the capital bars the sewers with his trident and bloodflame.

接肢贵族.name: Grafted Scion
接肢贵族.lore: A many-armed noble alternates twin-sword flurries with the protection of a greatshield.

狮子混种.name: Leonine Misbegotten
狮子混种.lore: A lion-maned misbegotten lunges ferociously with a greatsword.

熔炉骑士.name: Crucible Knight
熔炉骑士.lore: An ancient knight fights with sword, shield, and incantations that echo the Crucible of life.

熔炉骑士奥陶琵斯.name: Crucible Knight Ordovis
熔炉骑士奥陶琵斯.lore: The knight's spinning greatsword draws forth the golden power of the Crucible.

熔炉骑士志留亚.name: Crucible Knight Siluria
熔炉骑士志留亚.lore: Her tree spear gathers the spiraling life force of the Crucible.

铁棘艾隆梅尔.name: Elemer of the Briar
铁棘艾隆梅尔.lore: His executioner's sword spins beyond his grasp, while briar-covered armor punishes those who draw near.

铃珠猎人.name: Bell Bearing Hunter
铃珠猎人.lore: Commands a sword from afar to take the bell bearings of wandering merchants.

黑刀刺客.name: Black Knife Assassin
黑刀刺客.lore: The death imbued in her black knife lends itself to swift assassination.

黑刀之首亚勒托.name: Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader
黑刀之首亚勒托.lore: The assassins' leader meets her foes with a deathly black knife and swift leaping attacks.

猎犬骑士达瑞威尔.name: Bloodhound Knight Darriwil
猎犬骑士达瑞威尔.lore: Bloodhound footwork and curved claws make his close-range slashes difficult to catch.

猎犬骑士弗罗.name: Bloodhound Knight Floh
猎犬骑士弗罗.lore: A loyal bloodhound knight guards a cavern in obedience to his lord's command.

黑夜骑兵.name: Night's Cavalry
黑夜骑兵.lore: A heavily armored rider patrols only at night, wielding a flail or polearm.

死亡鸟.name: Deathbird
死亡鸟.lore: A gaunt, monstrous bird attacks night travelers with a hooked poker and a curse of death.

死之鸟.name: Death Rite Bird
死之鸟.lore: Spreads its wings to perform death's rites and call forth cold ghostflame.

腐败树灵.name: Putrid Tree Spirit
腐败树灵.lore: Its immense, rootlike body spews scarlet rot.

溃烂树灵.name: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
溃烂树灵.lore: A twisted tree spirit charges with its entire body and erupts in golden flame.

黄金树的化身.name: Erdtree Avatar
黄金树的化身.lore: A giant guardian of a Minor Erdtree wields a staff and casts holy light.

腐败化身.name: Putrid Avatar
腐败化身.lore: An avatar tainted by rot leaves dangerous, poisonous ground in its wake.

归树看门犬.name: Erdtree Burial Watchdog
归树看门犬.lore: A statue-like watchdog guards the tomb with stiff leaps and magic.

守墓斗士.name: Grave Warden Duelist
守墓斗士.lore: A catacomb duelist swings great hammers fastened to chains.

发狂斗士.name: Putrid Grave Warden Duelist
发狂斗士.lore: The corrupted duelist's heavy blows spread scarlet rot.

石挖山妖.name: Stonedigger Troll
石挖山妖.lore: A tunnel troll with rocky skin shakes loose showers of stone with its club.

诺克斯剑士.name: Nox Swordstress
诺克斯剑士.lore: A swordstress of the Eternal City attacks with the flowing reach of a liquid blade.

诺克斯修士.name: Nox Monk
诺克斯修士.lore: Guards the Eternal City with silver armor and a flowing hammer.

仿身泪滴.name: Mimic Tear
仿身泪滴.lore: A silver tear takes its opponent's shape, copying equipment and fighting techniques.

英雄石像鬼.name: Valiant Gargoyle
英雄石像鬼.lore: Mended with corpse wax, the gargoyle swings paired colossal weapons.

黑剑眷属.name: Black Blade Kindred
黑剑眷属.lore: A gargoyle serving the Black Blade imbues its colossal weapons with the power of death.

祖灵.name: Ancestor Spirit
祖灵.lore: A staglike ancestral spirit leaps upon spectral light and guards its homeland with spirit flame.

祖灵之王.name: Regal Ancestor Spirit
祖灵之王.lore: Draws life from spirit beasts to sustain the ancestral cycle.

龙人士兵.name: Dragonkin Soldier
龙人士兵.lore: A giant soldier seeking the power of dragons unleashes frozen lightning.

诺克史黛拉的龙人士兵.name: Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella
诺克史黛拉的龙人士兵.lore: The underground dragonkin soldier sweeps the wetlands with a spear of frozen lightning.

鲜血贵族.name: Sanguine Noble
鲜血贵族.lore: A noble serving the blood dynasty fights with a thrusting sword and blades of blood.

战场魔法师.name: Battlemage
战场魔法师.lore: An armored mage bombards enemies with magical cannon fire and a stone hammer.

魔法教授米丽安.name: Preceptor Miriam
魔法教授米丽安.lore: The preceptor of the inverted study hall holds visitors at bay with a magical greatbow.

红狼拉达冈.name: Red Wolf of Radagon
红狼拉达冈.lore: The red wolf alternates swift bites with glintblade sorcery.

英雄红狼.name: Red Wolf of the Champion
英雄红狼.lore: A red wolf roaming a hero's grave commands glintblades and fiery red fangs.

结晶人.name: Crystalian
结晶人.lore: Its crystal shell resists cutting weapons; only after it breaks do the creature's weaknesses appear.

腐败结晶人.name: Putrid Crystalian
腐败结晶人.lore: Rot has invaded its crystal shell, lending corruption to its spinning attacks and crystal sorcery.

神皮使徒.name: Godskin Apostle
神皮使徒.lore: A god-hunting apostle stretches his body and fights with black flame and a twinblade.

神皮贵族.name: Godskin Noble
神皮贵族.lore: A corpulent noble pressures foes with a thrusting sword and crushing rolls.

神皮双人组.name: Godskin Duo
神皮双人组.lore: The apostle and noble rise again in turn, combining their black flames.

老将欧尼尔.name: Commander O'Neil
老将欧尼尔.lore: The swamp veteran summons dead soldiers with his standard and scatters scarlet rot.

老将尼奥.name: Commander Niall
老将尼奥.lore: The one-legged veteran guards Castle Sol with a battle standard and a lightning-charged prosthesis.

坠星兽物.name: Fallingstar Beast
坠星兽物.lore: An armored beast uses gravity and charging attacks to defend a meteor's landing ground.

成年坠星兽物.name: Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast
成年坠星兽物.lore: The mature beast unleashes stronger gravity and tears rocks from the ground.

石肤白王.name: Alabaster Lord
石肤白王.lore: An ancient pale-skinned lord draws enemies toward his blade with waves of gravity.

石肤黑王.name: Onyx Lord
石肤黑王.lore: The dark-skinned lord summons meteors and commands gravity with a curved sword.

艾丝缇.name: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
艾丝缇.lore: An alien born of a nebula bombards its foes with starlight and a barbed tail.

黑暗繁星艾丝缇.name: Astel, Stars of Darkness
黑暗繁星艾丝缇.lore: An astral monstrosity fills deep tunnels with meteors and nebulae.

恶兆孪生子.name: Fell Twins
恶兆孪生子.lore: A pair of Omens seal off the Divine Tower with great blades and blood-colored flame.

腐败眷属.name: Kindred of Rot
腐败眷属.lore: An insectlike servant of rot attacks with threads and a polearm.

飞龙亚基尔.name: Flying Dragon Agheel
飞龙亚基尔.lore: The flying dragon of Limgrave's lake guards its territory with fiery breath.

辉石龙史玛拉格.name: Glintstone Dragon Smarag
辉石龙史玛拉格.lore: A dragon that devours sorcerers patrols the academy with magical breath.

辉石龙亚杜拉.name: Glintstone Dragon Adula
辉石龙亚杜拉.lore: A glintstone dragon serving the Lunar Princess commands a freezing blade of moonlight.

熔岩土龙马卡尔.name: Magma Wyrm Makar
熔岩土龙马卡尔.lore: A crawling wyrm bears a scalesword and spews magma.

大土龙席欧朵利克.name: Great Wyrm Theodorix
大土龙席欧朵利克.lore: The great wyrm guards its snowy resting place with a colossal sword and magma.

冰结湖的玻列琉斯.name: Borealis the Freezing Fog
冰结湖的玻列琉斯.lore: The mountaintop ice dragon exhales deadly frost through a veil of white mist.

腐败龙艾格基斯.name: Decaying Ekzykes
腐败龙艾格基斯.lore: A flying dragon ravaged by scarlet rot exhales its corruption.

飞龙桂雷尔.name: Flying Dragon Greyll
飞龙桂雷尔.lore: A huge flying dragon keeps watch over the bridge in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow.

普拉顿桑克斯.name: Dragonlord Placidusax
普拉顿桑克斯.lore: Hidden beyond time, the ancient Dragonlord meets intruders with red lightning and dragon breath.

兰沙克.name: Ancient Dragon Lansseax
兰沙克.lore: The ancient dragon once taught in human form; her red lightning now sweeps the plateau.

弗尔桑克斯.name: Lichdragon Fortissax
弗尔桑克斯.lore: The ancient dragon fought death for a dear friend, only to become entwined in death lightning.

大龙桂奥尔.name: Elder Dragon Greyoll
大龙桂奥尔.lore: Though aged, the mother of dragons still commands her young with a mighty roar.

葛瑞克士兵.name: Godrick Soldier
葛瑞克士兵.lore: A soldier of Limgrave guards the roads with spear, shield, and crossbow.

雷亚卢卡利亚士兵.name: Raya Lucaria Soldier
雷亚卢卡利亚士兵.lore: A soldier of Liurnia fights with weapons protected by magic.

拉塔恩士兵.name: Radahn Soldier
拉塔恩士兵.lore: A Redmane soldier kindles flame to resist scarlet rot.

罗德尔士兵.name: Leyndell Soldier
罗德尔士兵.lore: A soldier of the capital guards its gates with a long spear and lightning incantations.

圣树士兵.name: Haligtree Soldier
圣树士兵.lore: A defender of Miquella's Haligtree relies on holy light and self-sacrifice.

流刑士兵.name: Exile Soldier
流刑士兵.lore: A red-hooded exile guards the castle with a spear and storm pots.

失乡骑士.name: Banished Knight
失乡骑士.lore: An armored knight bereft of his homeland wields a greatsword with storm techniques.

流浪贵族.name: Wandering Noble
流浪贵族.lore: A noble stripped of former status wanders among the ruins.

贵族魔法师.name: Noble Sorcerer
贵族魔法师.lore: A fallen noble survives through elementary glintstone sorcery.

白金之子.name: Albinauric
白金之子.lore: An artificial life-form seeks refuge among the lakes and snowfields.

第二代白金之子.name: Second-Generation Albinauric
第二代白金之子.lore: A frog-like Albinauric swarms its foes with rolling attacks and clubs.

白金之子弓手.name: Albinauric Archer
白金之子弓手.lore: An expert Albinauric archer holds enemies back from afar with magical arrows.

亚人.name: Demi-Human
亚人.lore: A nocturnal demi-human launches ambushes with short weapons.

亚人女王.name: Demi-Human Queen
