火焰骑士昆兰.lore: A red-robed knight casts seeking flames at intruders.

火焰骑士希德.name: Fire Knight Hilde
火焰骑士希德.lore: A fire knight in Messmer's service fights with a fire spear and spells.

丹恩.name: Dryleaf Dane
丹恩.lore: A monk of the Dryleaf order practices with fists, feet, and unwavering faith.

墓地鼠.name: Graveyard Rat
墓地鼠.lore: Its fighting style brings the Dark element into the game's sacrifice system.

卡利亚骑士.name: Carian Knight
卡利亚骑士.lore: Its fighting style brings the Light element into the game's sacrifice system.

玛莲妮亚·金辉.name: Gilded Malenia, Blade of Miquella
玛莲妮亚·金辉.lore: Where her blade passes, spilled blood becomes a golden glimmer of renewed resolve.

“穿刺者”梅瑟莫·金辉.name: Gilded Messmer the Impaler
“穿刺者”梅瑟莫·金辉.lore: A fire serpent coils around a golden spear; the victor's blood keeps an exiled edge burning.

神兽舞狮·金辉.name: Gilded Divine Beast Dancing Lion
神兽舞狮·金辉.lore: To the sound of golden bells, the divine beast stamps up thunderclouds, its heavy lion's head shielding the tower people's last line.

双月骑士蕾菈娜·金辉.name: Gilded Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
双月骑士蕾菈娜·金辉.lore: Twin moons light her golden blades; after she is gone, an unread vow still points toward another path.

树影化身·金辉.name: Gilded Scadutree Avatar
树影化身·金辉.lore: A golden flower opens again among its wounds, leaving the land a final spark even in its last withering.

葛瑞克·金辉.name: Gilded Godrick the Grafted
葛瑞克·金辉.lore: Borrowed arms gleam with gold; each fallen opponent adds another grasping measure of greed to his cumbersome kingship.

艾尔登之兽·金辉.name: Gilded Elden Beast
艾尔登之兽·金辉.lore: The Order becomes flowing gold; starlight passes beyond the blades to grant the unseen law one more breath.

“约定之王”拉塔恩·金辉.name: Gilded Promised Consort Radahn
“约定之王”拉塔恩·金辉.lore: Twin swords uphold a softly golden vow; returned from the place of fallen stars, the lord holds the final lane for a shared destiny.

蕾娜拉·金辉.name: Gilded Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
蕾娜拉·金辉.lore: The full moon rises once more over golden waters as the queen folds a broken star chart into the entrance to another dream.

玛尔基特·金辉.name: Gilded Margit, the Fell Omen
玛尔基特·金辉.lore: A ragged cloak cannot conceal golden phantom weapons; the gate's watchman drives hesitant Tarnished back toward an unkindled road.

拉达冈·金辉.name: Gilded Radagon of the Golden Order
拉达冈·金辉.lore: Shattered gold is set into a body of stone; after the sacred hammer falls, a final resolve to mend the world still shines behind him.

“暴虐”贝勒·金辉.name: Gilded Bayle the Dread
“暴虐”贝勒·金辉.lore: Broken wings bear golden flame-lightning; with every kill, the wounded dragon regains the strength to hurl itself at the sky.

黄金树守卫·金辉.name: Gilded Tree Sentinel
黄金树守卫·金辉.lore: Gold has always belonged to the Erdtree's knight; greatshield and halberd together guard the first road.

红狼拉达冈·金辉.name: Gilded Red Wolf of Radagon
红狼拉达冈·金辉.lore: Golden magic becomes a blade along the red wolf's fangs; its watch over the academy never ended when its master departed.

拉塔恩·金辉.name: Gilded Starscourge Radahn
拉塔恩·金辉.lore: Gold lights twin swords and a little horse; at the general's roar, the fallen stars finally begin to move again.

龙装大树守卫·金辉.name: Gilded Draconic Tree Sentinel
龙装大树守卫·金辉.lore: Red lightning crawls over golden dragon armor; the knight at the capital's gate still stands as its final wall.

蒙葛特·金辉.name: Gilded Morgott, the Omen King
蒙葛特·金辉.lore: Golden grace once rejected his name, yet his cursed sword still protects the tree that never accepted him.

拉卡德·金辉.name: Gilded Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
拉卡德·金辉.lore: Gold entwines with devouring flame; the serpent lord promises that every rebel will be family forever.

莫格·金辉.name: Gilded Mohg, Lord of Blood
莫格·金辉.lore: Bloodflame carves a countdown into the gold; the blood dynasty's blessing never seeks its sacrifice's consent.

火焰巨人·金辉.name: Gilded Fire Giant
火焰巨人·金辉.lore: Gold reflects the ancient fury in a single eye; the giant beside the forbidden flame still has nowhere left to retreat.

玛利喀斯·金辉.name: Gilded Maliketh, the Black Blade
玛利喀斯·金辉.lore: Destined Death cleaves the gold; when the Black Blade falls, even vows of immortality lose their meaning.

葛孚雷·金辉.name: Gilded Godfrey, First Elden Lord
葛孚雷·金辉.lore: Gold settles once more upon the first lord's axe; when the lion falls away, only a true warrior remains.
